\[
L = \nabla^2 (G_{\sigma} * I),
\qquad
E(p) = 255 \;\text{ if }\; L(p) < 0 \;\text{ and }\; \exists\, q \in N_4(p) : L(q) > 0,\; L(q) - L(p) > T
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(L\): The Laplacian of Gaussian
- \(T\): The threshold

Marr and Hildreth proposed to smooth with a Gaussian and look for the zero crossings of the Laplacian. At an edge the first derivative has its extremum, so the second derivative crosses zero. The LoG is the one in this catalog, truncated at 4 sigma, and the crossing rule marks the negative side, as in the zero-crossing detector.
